name: Sour Diesel Live Resin Cannon 3-pack | 1.5g
description: Introducing the NEW Cannon Live Resin 3 Pack. Each pack includes three 0.5g Cannons, totaling 1.5 grams. What sets these Cannons apart is their premium flower combined with 100% live resin, delivering a full spectrum high terpene extract made from fresh frozen flower.
